title: Road traffic counts (hourly)
summary: Hourly vehicle counts from road counters near the air-quality monitoring stations in Valdena. Each row records one counter for one hour. The data covers the 2024-2025 production window, with rows from 2021-01-01 onward and still updating hourly. On 2024-03-18 the counters were replaced, changing the measurement from per-direction to combined-direction counts, which breaks comparability across that date. The table has no geolocation columns, so the proximity to specific air-quality stations would need to be resolved from a separate mapping of counter_ids to station locations.

spatial.notes: No geolocation columns in the table. counter_id values are road counter codes whose locations are not documented in this table or its catalog entry. Proximity to air-quality stations is unclear from this source alone.

documentation_excerpts: Catalog: 'Vehicles counted per hour by road counters near the monitoring stations.'

Wiki (counter_replacement_2024, last_edited=2024-04-02): 'On 2024-03-18 the road counters were replaced. Before that date, counts were recorded per direction. From 2024-03-18, counts are both directions combined. Do not compare counts across the change without adjusting for it.'
quality_notes: The catalog entry describes the table as active and has 3 columns (counter_id, ts_local, vehicles) with no mention of a direction column. The wiki page counter_replacement_2024 (last edited 2024-04-02) states that counts before 2024-03-18 were per-direction and after are combined-direction. This means the same column (vehicles) has a different semantic before and after the counter replacement, making time-series comparisons across that date invalid without a conversion factor. The catalog entry itself has no note about this break — contradiction between catalog (no mention) and wiki (explicit warning).

No geolocation columns are present, so it is not possible to verify from this table alone which counters are 'near the monitoring stations' as described. A separate mapping or lookup table would be needed.
Access requires a request to the Mobility Office; the candidate notes a separate data-sharing agreement may be needed.
